recipe.visualDefinition: A full-length studio portrait of a female figure centered against a neutral, slightly warm-grey background, flanked by bold, tightly-spaced sans-serif typography that wraps around the subject's torso.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject acts as a vertical divider for the horizontal text lines
Text color echoes the dark tones of the subject's footwear and shadows
High-contrast texture of the knit sweater against the smooth, flat background
coreInvariants: Full-body vertical orientation of the subject
Tight letter-spacing (kerning) in all typographic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered vertically, occupying approximately 80% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bold primary text line at chest level.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move left to the first word, then right across the subject to the second word, then down to the subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample open space on the left and right margins to emphasize the central figure.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm off-white/grey background providing a clean canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep chocolate brown for typography and leather boots.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Tawny and honey tones in the subject's hair and knitwear.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark text and light background.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight tracking where characters nearly touch
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family variation using weight and case to distinguish hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic mid-century grotesque with the correct weight and neutrality.
Provides a slightly more vintage, sturdy feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of a woman in a 1960s style chunky knit sweater and tall boots, standing in profile but looking at the camera, centered against a plain light grey wall.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold sans-serif text in dark brown. Place the main name in all-caps across the middle, split so half is on the left and half is on the right of the subject. Place the subtitle in lowercase directly below it using the same split method.

verificationChecks: Is the text tracking tight enough that letters almost touch?
Is the color palette restricted to browns and greys?
Does the text appear to be 'behind' the subject's silhouette where they meet?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of brown for text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text overlaps the subject's face
Check that the background is a flat, matte surface
Confirm the font weight is sufficiently heavy
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a centered studio portrait + split bold sans-serif text across the subject's midline + use a monochromatic earth-tone palette.
